import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { invalidateEventCommandEntry } from '@src/api/bot/command-entry';
import { invalidateEventBackendRobotIdentity } from '@src/api/bot/identity';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/start/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { formatName } from '@src/utils/name';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const GUIDE_ACTION_BAR = [
  { label: '继续', command: '/继续' },
  { label: '跳过引导', command: '/跳过引导' }
];

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await App({
    bid,
    guildId: e.GuildId,
    channelId: e.ChannelId,
    messageText: e.MessageText,
    request: createBackendRequestContext(e)
  });

  if (result.code === 'OK') {
    invalidateEventBackendRobotIdentity(e);
    invalidateEventCommandEntry(e);
  }

  if (result.code === 'EXISTING_USER') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('可发送 /我 查看账号信息。');

    md.addNewline();
    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '踏入仙途',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '我', command: '/我' },
          { label: '查看主线', command: '/查看主线' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'NEED_NAME') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('欢迎踏入修仙世界！');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('请输入你的道号，开始修仙之旅。');

    md.addNewline();
    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '踏入仙途',
        content: md,
        bar: [{ label: `我是 ${formatName(e?.UserName)}`, command: `/我是 ${formatName(e?.UserName)}` }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'INVALID_NAME' || result.code === 'NAME_TAKEN') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.code === 'NAME_TAKEN' ? '该道号已有人使用，请更换一个道号。' : result.data.message);

    md.addNewline();
    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '踏入仙途',
        content: md,
        bar: [{ label: `我是 ${formatName(e?.UserName)}`, command: `/我是 ${formatName(e?.UserName)}` }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('创建存档失败，请稍后再试或联系运营。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addBold('新手引导');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`${result.data.playerName}，你的仙途从此刻开始。`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(
    '"你独行于陨星荒野，夜色浓如墨，四周草木无声。忽然，一阵阴冷的笑声自身后传来——"呵呵，又是一只迷途的羔羊……"你猛然回头，只见一名黑袍修士手持炼魂幡，正缓步逼近。"'
  );

  md.addNewline();

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '',
      content: md,
      bar: GUIDE_ACTION_BAR
    })
  );
});
